scope: Source-owned LineBatch overlay callback exclusion with existing deferred engine-post protocol
finding: Sole source caller of draw_line_overlays_after_battle_tick is registered EngineTickPost callback. Strict TickApplication early return alone does not exclude initial unwind callbacks. Existing UE4SS_DeferEngineTickPost inside engine override makes DetourInstance return before postcallbacks; UE4SS_CompleteEngineTickPost invokes them once after engine completion. Preserve callback arguments and pending phase, no suppression or early completion. This supplies shared host/framework scheduling boundary for known mod writers, not a universal native LineBatch lock.
limits: No claim of exhaustive native DrawDebug append writer closure or external callback exclusion. Exact B undo after C drain still needs line/point/mesh data and render ownership, or proven empty immutable contract. Native destruction and UWorld monitors do not serialize ordinary line writes.
